# Feature: AppFlow frontier-based state exploration

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-10-04 — issue 384 / PR-10 -->

## Intent

Replace fixed 8×4/5 AppFlow sampling with deduplicated safe frontier exploration until the frontier is exhausted or an explicit barrier/budget/timeout stops the crawl.

## Preconditions

- Preview baseUrl available
- Screen graph with route screens
- SafeActionPolicy unchanged (no form submits / destructive / auto-auth)

## Happy Path

- [ ] Newly discovered safe route/state identities are enqueued and visited (deduped)
- [ ] Result includes terminationReason: frontier-exhausted | budget | timeout | auth-barrier | safety-barrier
- [ ] Fixed 8-screen slice is not the normal completion criterion
- [ ] Loops / dynamic IDs stay bounded via normalized state keys
- [ ] maxScreens acts as visit budget ceiling, not “done after 8 seeds”

## Edge Cases

- [ ] Empty screens → termination frontier-exhausted / no work
- [ ] Auth wall URL/login → auth-barrier
- [ ] Safety policy rejects all candidates → may still frontier-exhausted after visits
- [ ] Timeout budget → timeout

## Regression

- [ ] SafeActionPolicy still gates clicks
- [ ] Existing crawl result shape (snapshots, verifiedEdges, stateScreens, issues) preserved
- [ ] Live/preview adapter still calls runRuntimeCrawl

## Assumptions

- Default visitBudget = 40; clickBudgetPerVisit = 5; timeoutMs = 120000
- Call sites may still pass maxScreens as visitBudget alias

## Implementation Notes

- Files: preview-runner/lib/frontier-explorer.js, runtime-crawl.js, run-local-appflow-crawl.ts, preview-runner/index.js
- Tests: preview-runner/lib/frontier-explorer.test.mjs

## Composition Gate

### Event

Crawl starts with seed screens → frontier queue → visit → discover → enqueue → terminate.

### Hops

1. seedFrontier(route screens)
2. pop + visit + safe clicks
3. discover route/state → normalizeStateKey → enqueue if unseen
4. decideTermination → summary.terminationReason

### Simulations

| Case              | Expected           | Observed |
| ----------------- | ------------------ | -------- |
| Two linked routes | both visited       |          |
| Dynamic id path   | one identity       |          |
| Budget 1          | termination budget |          |
